description.text: Fujian Medical University (FMU) is located in Fuzhou（福州市）, Fujian Province. Fuzhou is the capital city of Fujian, with a history of more than 2,000 years, flaunting its modern cityscape. Intake: March, 2023 Tuition fee: 9000RMB/Semester Teahing Medium: English Duration: One semester (After pre-medicine study, you will have bigger chance tobe admitted by MBBS program)

duration.text: The Pre-medicine Program at Fujian Medical University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1250 USD/per year ￥ 9000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Scanned copy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form 6. Scanned copy of the original school report cards of all subjects with their notarial certificates;

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport and in good health 2. Senior high school graduates or with educational background at above level, or equivalent to that of a Chinese senior high school graduate or above, with results of B or above (more than 70 for a hundred-mark system) 3. Language requirements: Applicants for majors taught in English must possess with a relatively higher level of proficiency in English. Certificates for English learning throughout the primary and high schools or certificate for English proficiency test shall be produced for non-English native speakers.
